page.overview:
What is Ruined Inn?

This ruined inn, situated on the southern shore of Ard Skellig, is initially overrun by sirens, an ekhidna, and wraiths.

It'll give 170 and 50 for liberating this area from the monsters. Note that the monster nest has to be destroyed before the site is considered liberated.
